verdict.rationale: First-party material states that Gitea manages requirements, features and bugs through kanban boards [gitea-docs-21]. It also tracks project work 'through columns and issues', with milestones, assignments and due dates on those issues [gitea-docs-6, gitea-docs-17]. That directly covers planning and tracking work on column-based boards, though both mentions are brief marketing-level statements. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of board and column management (creating or customizing columns, moving cards), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the kanban feature.
